name: Ink Shield
body:
Constant manipulation of your magical tattoos has rewarded you with the capability to physically change them and to create an ink defense.

Prerequisite(s): Manipulate Ink

Benefit(s): As an immediate action you can expel ink from your tattoos, creating a thin barrier which can deflect incoming attacks. This grants you cover like a low obstacle until the beginning of your next turn. If an attack misses you by 4 or less it strikes the ink shield, causing it to dissipate and removing the cover bonus.

This action can be performed a number of times per day equal to your total number of tattoos.
